  "summary": "S1 — Fact: deliver a Python command-line tool that reads sales CSV files and prints total revenue, revenue by region, and units by product; its users invoke it from a command line and see the summary on standard output. S2 — Fact: add tests covering the requested behavior and relevant failures. Fact: the repository is empty and this unattended intake implements nothing; discovery should inspect the workspace and runtime for the questions above. No team, channels, internal sites, private repositories, owners, prior run, or other source hints are named; sales schema and output conventions are ambiguous terms to investigate. Keep any sensitive locator in an authorized private store, never in committed KNOWLEDGE/. The requested repository outcome becomes usable in the delivered source checkout after final return; an isolated run's source checkout remains at its snapshot until then. No deployed target or release is requested."
